limits: the Lean forms are executable (partial definitions for the searches), not proofs that they equal the paper's definitions; agreement is on seeded generated codes
name: W1_definitions_run

provenance.source: Gödel 1931, section 2, in Martin Hirzel's translation; The Gödel Method handover, W-1

statement: All 46 of Gödel's definitions run as cards. The 45 primitive recursive ones have a Python and a Lean form, which agree on all 237 generated calls (pass); 60 generated formulas round-trip (code, decode, parse; pass); and the direct forms equal the paper's own bounded searches on all 766 small inputs those searches can finish (pass). Definition 46, provable, is a Σ1 proposition in Lean and a search over given candidates in Python.
